title: Actions run in EVA instances; the in-process executor goes
goal: The scheduler no longer runs actions in process: each runs in an instance of its class, and the in-process path and its tests are removed
acceptance: Every action runs in an EVA instance of its admitted class, with its receipt, events and limits; the scheduler runs none in process
The dead in-process path and its tests go
Planned in steps of at most a day before work starts (owner rule), including the Linux and Windows bases
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
validation: Join tests across scheduler, runner and ledger per class; npm test
escalation: Its step plan and any change to which bases can run actions go to the owner first

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-19 when split from F-049-T07 (owner decision): every executor leaves the nervous process, which runs them today with direct database access. Not a measurement.
